summary: CitroTech Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a joint venture with Hexion Inc. to form HexiTech LLC for developing fire-retardant products. Each holds 50% membership. No price per share or premium is involved; it is an operational joint venture, not a merger, acquisition, or other special situation. The board of managers includes designees from each member. There is no regulatory clock or risk-arb angle. This is a routine entry into a material definitive agreement, not a special-situation event.
